front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《3》

en: I urge you: drink one more cup of wine
West beyond Yang Pass, no old friend remains
The orchid-boat urges its departure -- go, or not?

points.zh:
渭城朝雨浥輕塵，客舍青青柳色新。 
勸君更進一杯酒，西出陽關無故人。
--唐 。王維《 渭城曲 》
寒蟬淒切，對長亭晚，
驟雨初歇。
都門帳飲無緒，
留戀處、蘭舟催發。
執手相看淚眼，
竟無語凝噎。
念去去、千里煙波，
暮靄沉沉楚天闊。
--宋 。柳永《雨霖鈴》
points.en:
The morning rain at Weicheng moistens the light dust; the guesthouse is green, the willow colors fresh.
I urge you to drink one more cup of wine — west of Yangguan Pass there will be no old friends.
-- Tang dynasty. Wang Wei, 'Song of Weicheng'
The cicadas cry mournfully and forlorn,
facing the wayside pavilion at dusk,
a sudden shower has just stopped.
Drinking half-heartedly under a tent at the city gate,
lingering in reluctance — the orchid boat urges departure.
Hand in hand, we gaze at each other with tearful eyes,
too choked to speak.
I think of the journey ahead — a thousand miles of misty waves,
the evening haze hanging heavy over the vast southern sky.
-- Song dynasty. Liu Yong, 'Rain on the Bells'

en: In the afternoon, the lotus sits in silence
The dragonfly skims the water
The spirit of Zen drifts away on the wind
The fishing rod pauses in mid-air
Not knowing what has been caught on the line
The frog, plop, leaps down into the water

zh: The devil is in the details
en: Have you seen it all clearly?
In truth, this has nothing to do with eyesight
The devil is in the details

points.zh: The idiom, "The devil is in the detail" refers to a catch or mysterious element hidden in the details, meaning that something might seem simple at a first look but will take more time and effort to complete than expected and derives from the earlier phrase, "God is in the detail" expressing the idea that whatever one does should be done thoroughly; i.e. details are important.  (  from Wikipedia )

en: After the lingering violin falls silent
Now it is my story's turn
Your silence

zh: 廣場飄掦太陽花，街頭女孩
低聲求 : 買朵玉蘭花 ?
en: Jasmine blooming everywhere across the ground
Sunflowers drift across the square, a girl in the street
Softly pleading: won't you buy a magnolia blossom?

points.zh:
茉莉花革命 ( Revolution de jasmine ) ，指發生於2010年末至2011年初，北非突尼西亞反政府示威，導致政權倒台的事件。因茉莉花是該國國花而得名。這是阿拉伯國家中第一個因人民起義，導致推翻現任政權的革命。茉莉花革命的示威抗議模式為其他國家民眾所效法，如阿爾及利亞，埃及等，在其後幾個月內反政府示威浪潮，波及整個北非和中東地區。突尼西亞此後成立過渡政府，成爲茉莉花革命中，唯一達成民主轉型的國家。
太陽花運動是指2014年3月18日，反對中國國民黨單方面將《海峽两岸服務貿易恊議》宣告存查的學生所發起佔據立法院議場的行動。而在這同時來自台灣各地的學生和群眾紛紛前往立法院聲援，形勢湧汹，從而發展為後來的太陽花世代學運。影響所及包括2016的政黨輪替，時代力量的興起等。
玉蘭花又名白蘭，白玉蘭，望春花等，因其花苞開放時，有如白玉酒杯聳立枝頭，又幽香宛若蘭花，而得名「玉蘭」。早期的婦女更常將花朵做為髮飾或別在衣襟上做裝飾，不但美觀又香味宜人，一直深受台灣人喜愛。數百年前遠渡重洋來台灣的玉蘭花，早已深入尋常百姓的生活與感情，成為代表台灣本土最美的花。王蘭花性喜濕熱，台灣玉蘭花的最大產地是屏東縣高樹鄉和鹽埔鄉。
points.en:
The Jasmine Revolution (Révolution de jasmin) refers to the anti-government demonstrations in Tunisia, North Africa, from late 2010 to early 2011, which led to the collapse of the ruling regime. It takes its name from jasmine, Tunisia's national flower. It was the first revolution among Arab nations in which a popular uprising toppled the ruling government. The Jasmine Revolution's model of protest was emulated by people in other countries such as Algeria and Egypt, and in the following months a wave of anti-government demonstrations spread across North Africa and the Middle East. Tunisia subsequently established a transitional government and became the only country of the Jasmine Revolution to achieve a democratic transition.
The Sunflower Movement refers to the student-led occupation of the Legislative Yuan's main chamber beginning March 18, 2014, in opposition to the Kuomintang's unilateral move to have the Cross-Strait Service Trade Agreement declared as merely 'filed for reference' rather than substantively reviewed. At the same time, students and members of the public from all over Taiwan flocked to the Legislative Yuan in support, and the momentum surged, eventually developing into what became known as the Sunflower Generation student movement. Its effects included the 2016 change in ruling party and the rise of the New Power Party, among others.
The Yulan flower, also known as bailan, baiyulan, or 'flower that longs for spring,' gets its name 'yulan' (jade orchid) because its buds, when opening, resemble a jade wine cup rising above the branch, and its subtle fragrance recalls that of an orchid. In earlier times, women often wore the blossoms as hair ornaments or pinned them to their lapels — both beautiful to look at and pleasantly fragrant — and they have long been beloved by the people of Taiwan. Having crossed the ocean to Taiwan hundreds of years ago, the yulan flower has long been woven into the daily life and affections of ordinary people, becoming one of the flowers most representative of Taiwan's local beauty. The yulan favors heat and humidity; the largest production areas for yulan in Taiwan are Gaoshu Township and Yanpu Township in Pingtung County.

zh: 三輪車夫，補鞋匠，捻麵人---
一聲“ 燒肉粽 ”驚醒了我
en: Met at a corner of the street of dreams
The pedicab driver, the cobbler, the noodle-twister---
A cry of "roasted meat dumplings!" startled me awake
Once the rice paper is spread open
The rice ears have ripened to gold
Impressions of home
This song still makes me sorrowful
Sorrowful, and so far away
A few scenes I cannot forget
You gradually sink into the scenery
Forming mountains and forests, chasing wind and cloud
An afternoon at the art museum

points.zh:
不要說話
陪我獨處。看
一卷橫軸正開展
黃昏有些清涼
山有些紫
林有些深
我們背手雲遊
整個世界正在打烊 .....
--羅智成《 壁畫。在阿里山 》
